name: Shared Rhythm
idea: Four unequal folded planes hold an open gathering space; their rising and falling intervals suggest shared praise.

meaning.tabernacle: Turning architectural faces hold an open, welcoming forecourt.
meaning.praise: Changing height and spacing suggest collective rhythm and uplift, without literal music symbols.
meaning.relationship: The same four planes carry both the gathering-space and rhythm readings.

construction: Four separate flat filled polygons on a 256 × 256 canvas.
Tallest plane is inner-right; outer faces are deliberately lower.
A shared open lower interior preserves welcome and depth; there is no level skyline baseline.
The second face retains its projecting apex and slight taper from the liked raster.
changes: Primary v2 widens the first interval by two units only.
Alternative v3 shortens the projecting apex and raises the two inner lower edges by three units.
strengths: Preserves the user-favored silhouette and welcoming asymmetric feel.
A single spatial arrangement carries both dwelling and rhythm.
Broad planes and generous central space are strong in monochrome.
risks: Can read as a cultural venue, property identity or sculptural architecture.
Praise is abstract, rather than immediately musical or specifically Christian.
At 16 pixels, antialiasing joins two adjacent faces; 24 pixels and above preserve all four in these tests.
smallSize: Overall gesture remains at 16 px, but two faces touch through antialiasing. Four separate planes survive at 24/32/64 px. Spatial depth is clearest at 32 px and above. A future optical cut is needed for reliable 16 px use.
visualInspection: Rendered and viewed the three versions at large scale, black/reverse, and actual 16/24/32/64 px. Root should also inspect final combined presentation.
auditNotes: The audit flags slightly tapered edges and unequal vertical margins. These are inherited optical qualities of the favored drawing; the heuristic score is not visual approval.
font: No font dependency in the symbol. Board annotations use the repository Noto Sans file only.
